test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 27 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Easier said than done

options.text: Not as easy as it appears to be
Not as moderate as it appears to be
Not as restricted as it appears to be
Not as difficult as it appears to be

solution: The correct answer is **"Not as easy as it appears to be." **
